1.title: 5 Things to Know About Byron Donalds, Republican Nominee for Florida Governor
1.summary: Representative Donalds, the Republican nominee for governor of Florida, made a name as a Black conservative in Congress, but his loyalty to President Trump has been his ticket.

2.title: Former Republican David Jolly Wins Democratic Nomination for Florida Governor
2.summary: The former Republican congressman will try to appeal to voters disaffected with President Trump in a state where Republicans significantly outnumber Democrats.

3.title: 5 Things to Know About David Jolly, the Democratic Nominee for Florida Governor
3.summary: A former Republican, he plans to run on an affordability agenda.

4.title: Harvard agrees to pay millions after morgue manager sold body parts
4.summary: Harvard Medical School has agreed to pay $53 million to families who alleged the school mishandled the donated remains of loved ones.

5.title: Carney and Trump Talk Again as Deadline Nears on New U.S. Tariffs
5.summary: Canada is seeking a deal to dodge further economic pain at the hands of the Trump administration on midnight Tuesday. But at what cost?

6.title: ZZ Top drummer Frank Beard dies aged 77
6.summary: A statement on the blues-rock band's website said he died on Monday in hospice
